Positive K absorbs the arbitrary integration constant in all three integrals, on intervals avoiding the singularities. q-30052: (x-2)^2=9 gives p=-2, q=9 and roots -1,5, hence the requested values are 7 and 4. q-112487: (m+4)^2=8 gives p+q=12 and m=-4±2√2. q-86191: the chain rule gives 710e^t/(1+e^t)=710/(1+e^(-t)). q-2439: w'(1)=12-2=10. q-48742: P'(v)=-48/(v+1)^2, hence P'(5)=-4/3. q-48720: dA/dl=2l gives 12 cm²/cm at l=6 cm. q-24647: the double-angle identity gives 2sin(π/3); the source's wording 'a single trigonometric ratio' loosely describes this scaled sine expression. q-7305: doubling 3π/7 gives sin(6π/7). q-65609: expanding sin(π/5) and canceling cosine gives 2sin(π/10). q-120018: expanding the denominator and canceling cosine gives (1/2)csc(π/8). q-26907: the square equals 1+sin(210°)=1/2. q-24645: applying the double-angle identity twice gives sin(π/2)=1. q-1727: the cosine difference identity gives (√2-√6)/4.
